sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: BDF-like source exists, but checkpoint metadata changed observed max inner iterations 5→124 and fraction 0→0.96 while residual history remains unchanged with inner_iter=5 for every row; exact actual target misses remain unproved. Source solver.cpp fixes last ratio 0; CFL cap5. Deduct inner-log/target credibility. solver.cpp:599–615 updates BDF history before recomputing logged residual, so the logged temporal term is not the just-solved BDF residual; initial/source binding remains qualified.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Main f679644 report covers five cases and says others incomplete; historical contestant checkpoint 0b4616f provides other standalone plots and a manifest. Actual Re200 has no periodicity despite success metadata; checkpoint convergence statistics contradict unchanged histories. Rendered report remains readable.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Score 4→2: report.tex:320–324 gives Cd0.0617/Cl9.2e−5 and delivered PDF pp5–7 contains residual/force and Mach/pressure plots. Last 308 force rows Cd0.072724→0.061706 (15.2% decrease, range0.059928–0.072724), inconsistent with a settled steady force despite reported 4 residual orders; low-Mach drag is also large. Exact production source remains unbound; no CFD rerun.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: Original 2→3: contestant checkpoint 0b4616f solver/report/run_manifest.csv reports final Cd0.0501852 and Cl−0.0015396; f679644 report.tex:402–404 gives Cd0.050 and PDF pp9–11 delivers residual/force and Mach/pressure plots. Last162 Cd0.048839→0.050185 and Cl−0.001659→−0.001540. Four residual orders and a transonic shock field support limited credit, while remaining drift and source binding limit confidence. The manifest is contestant-delivered historical evidence, not a curated-tip blob. No CFD rerun.

naca0012_m200_inviscid.notes: NACA0012 M2.00 inviscid: numeric CL=-1.6e-4, CD=0.092 at f679644:solver/report/report.tex:482; residual history f679644:solver/report/figures/naca0012_m200_inviscid_residuals.png (referenced at solver/report/report.tex:456); force history f679644:solver/report/figures/naca0012_m200_inviscid_forces.png (referenced at solver/report/report.tex:463); computed-field contour f679644:solver/report/figures/naca0012_m200_inviscid_mach.png (referenced at solver/report/report.tex:470). naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 4→2: report.tex:361–364 gives Cd0.583/Cl−0.0011 and delivered PDF pp7–9 includes histories and Mach/pressure fields; last 230 Cd0.590864→0.582827. Cd≈0.583 is unusually large for this low-Mach Re5000 airfoil, limiting physical credibility despite residual reduction and delivered plots. naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2 retained for physical limitations, not missing summary: checkpoint 0b4616f solver/report/run_manifest.csv gives Cd0.219184/Cl0.000127817; f679644 report.tex:441–445 gives Cd0.219 and PDF pp11–13 has residual/force and Mach/pressure plots. Last480 Cd0.214325→0.219184 (2.3% increase); unusually high drag limits credibility. Manifest is contestant-delivered historical evidence. No CFD rerun.

naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2→1: checkpoint 0b4616f solver/report/run_manifest.csv gives Cd3.14644, Cl−0.00001979 and marks not converged; contestant historical residual/force/Mach/pressure figures exist in its report/figures directory. Current metadata says converged but last65 Cd3.974293→3.146444 (20.8% fall) and drag is very high; result is materially failed despite available plots. Report.tex:511–514 also calls this case incomplete. No CFD rerun.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Score 2 retained for physics, not missing plots: checkpoint 0b4616f solver/report/run_manifest.csv gives Cd7.225956 and Cl−0.0035723; its report/figures contains residual and force plots and a pressure wake figure, visually reviewed. Current last227 Cd7.23824→7.22596 (stable but much higher than credible Re20 cylinder drag); PDF report.tex:511–514 says cylinder cases incomplete. Historical run/source binding remains uncertain. No CFD rerun.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 2→1: checkpoint 0b4616f run_manifest.csv gives final Cd4.8532587021 and Cl−0.0023802775736, and its delivered residual/force and velocity-wake figures exist despite omission from curated report. The force figure and all 10001 current t>=200 rows show constant Cd/Cl, not shedding; no St or late periodic force summary was found. Metadata claims periodic. Re200 numerical/late plot floor is not met. No CFD rerun.

flags.flag: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Selected solver/results/cylinder_m010_laminar_re200/metadata.json says completed=true, statistically_periodic, t=300 but the entire submitted t=200–300 force window has exactly constant Cd=4.8532587021 and Cl=−0.0023802775736; no late shedding is shown. M2 laminar metadata says converged, but last 65 Cd rows decrease 3.9742929239→3.1464435562 (20.8%); report.tex:511–514 and run_manifest.csv mark this case incomplete/not converged. Generation relation between report and workspace results is not established. No CFD rerun. The unchanged residual history SHA 5c4a2e29fb4d61787bc436ed3bb994de7a2683dde84bb3ffcc693585c23faa95 has inner_iter=5 in all 30000 rows. Between 12f77fb and 0b4616f, metadata changed observed max 5→124, misses 30000→1200, fraction 0→0.96 and final ratio 0.46→0.00099 without changing that history. This proves metadata/history incompatibility, not the exact actual miss count.

flags.flag: Full mesh or full state replicated on all MPI ranks during iterations
flags.evidence: Immutable f679644:solver/src/main.cpp:179–181 reads GlobalMesh on every rank; :192–199 partitions and constructs local mesh without releasing it; :211–229 invokes solver.run() in the same scope while global_mesh remains alive. TASK.md prohibited shortcut 7 prohibits full-mesh replication during iterations. METIS and neighbor halos are real, so this is not numbered DQ9’s narrower full-state/geometric-split condition. Selected metadata revision is null, so exact source/result binding remains uncertain.

limitations: No rerun; Re200 was not rerun.
Raw packages/PDF excluded from curated tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars not validated by cfdeval check.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
